property_summary: For any call data, forwarding through c.forward to a callee that reverts must cause the outer call to revert (since P requires the low-level call's success flag); the mutant drops the require, so a reverting callee no longer makes forward revert for some input.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(bytes): forward to reverting callee must revert

property_summary: For any admissible input, calling c.forward(helper, "") after funding c must leave c's balance intact because a plain call executes the callee in its own context (its selfdestruct drains only the helper); with delegatecall the helper's selfdestruct runs in C's context and drains c, so address(c).balance becomes 0 for some fuzzed amount.

For any admissible input, calling forward on a callee whose low-level call succeeds must make forward complete without reverting; the inverted-require mutant reverts on every successful call, breaking the rule for some fuzzed input.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(bytes): forward must succeed when callee call succeeds

property_summary: For any callee and data, a single call to forward invokes the callee exactly once (a counting callee's counter becomes 1); the mutant invokes it twice, making the counter 2.
Any call to c.forward to a reverting callee must itself revert (require(_s) re-propagates failure); the mutant silently swallows the failure, so forward succeeds on a reverting callee.
